premise: This file carries the column definitions for the campaign ledger. The canonical ledger — tracking id, defined events, provenance trail and rows — is data/campaign-ledger.json; both files start empty on purpose. A column is filled only from an authorized first-party report, and every filled row carries the date the report was read. No estimate, projection or modelled figure belongs in either file.

definitions.timestamp: ISO 8601 UTC instant at which the row was recorded.
definitions.source: Where the numbers came from, naming the exact report — for example "Associates Click Reports" or "Associates Orders Report".
definitions.channel: Where the traffic was referred from. Must be a channel declared in the Associates account (S02).
definitions.eligible_sessions: Sessions as Amazon defines them: the session begins at the click-through and ends at 24 hours, an order, or another Special Link click (S02).
definitions.clicks: Outbound clicks reported by the Associates Click Reports for that channel and period.
definitions.reported_orders: Orders reported in the Associates Orders Report. Not inferred from clicks.
definitions.provenance: The document, export filename or screenshot the row was transcribed from, plus who read it.
frozen_rules: Never enter an estimated or modelled conversion rate.
Never reconcile a row that mixes an Associates figure with a site-side figure in one column.
Never backfill a date you did not actually read the report on.

note_for_reader: There are zero rows because the first report has not been read yet. That is the whole of what is known about this site's performance.
